DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の内容についてご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the details of your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の二時とメールにあります。家賃の振込も二時に実行される予約だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約メールの二時を家賃振込実行時刻と思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The email says two o'clock tomorrow. I thought it was also a scheduled transfer that would pay my rent at two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you mistook the two o'clock consultation appointment in the email for the time your rent transfer would be executed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらのメールは、窓口で相談する日時のご案内です。振込の実行予定とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This email tells you the date and time of your consultation at the counter. That is separate from a scheduled transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談の席を予約しただけですね。振込先も金額も、この予約には入力していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口相談のみで送金先や金額は未入力と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I only reserved a consultation slot. I haven't entered a recipient or amount for this appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that this is only a counter consultation and you have not entered a recipient or amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お支払いの期限は、ご自身で確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked the payment deadline yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明後日です。相談予約があるので支払いも済むと思い、まだ別の手続きをしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明後日の支払期限だがまだ振込手続きはしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's the day after tomorrow. I thought having a consultation appointment meant the payment would go through too, so I haven't taken any separate steps yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that payment is due the day after tomorrow but you have not yet arranged the transfer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込方法と実行の条件は、担当にご相談ください。ご相談だけで送金は行われません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the person in charge about transfer methods and the conditions for execution. A consultation alone does not send any money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。大家さんへも予約済みだから送金済みと伝えず、必要な手続きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約を送金済とは伝えず必要手続きを確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't tell my landlord the money has been sent just because I have an appointment. I'll check what I need to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will not describe the appointment as a completed transfer and will check the necessary procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日は振込先など、相談に必要な情報をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tomorrow, please bring the recipient details and any other information needed for the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手の指定を持ってきます。明日の相談時刻と明後日の期限を別にメモし、実行したかも自分で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談時刻と期限を分け指定情報を持参し実行有無も確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll bring the recipient's instructions. I'll note tomorrow's appointment time separately from the deadline the day after tomorrow, and check for myself whether the transfer has been executed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the consultation time and deadline separately, bring the specified information, and check whether the transfer has been executed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用件を確認できました。それでは、明日のご予約でお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your request. We look forward to seeing you at your appointment tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の数量限定商品の案内をご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking today's limited-quantity product information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 開店前から並びました。列にいれば一つ取り置きされたと思って、友達にも買えると伝えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開店前の列で商品確保済と思い友人へ約束したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lined up before opening. I thought being in line meant one had been reserved for me, and told my friend I could buy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought queuing before opening secured the item and promised your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列に並ぶことと商品が確保されることは同じではありません。販売の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Standing in line does not mean an item has been secured for you. Please check the sales information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。友達には、まだ商品を受け取っていないと訂正します。引換券なども持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未受取かつ券なしと友人へ訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll correct what I told my friend and say I haven't received an item yet. I don't have a redemption ticket or anything either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you will correct your friend’s understanding: you have not received the item and have no ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お一人当たりの数量や、商品の受け取り方はこちらに掲示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The quantity allowed per person and how to collect the item are posted here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人一つの案内ですね。友達の分も欲しくて二つと考えていましたが、今の条件を読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人一つの案内を読み二つの希望を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says one per person. I was thinking of two because I wanted one for my friend as well, but I'll reread the current conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the one-per-person notice and reconsider your wish to buy two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 売場へ進まれる際も、係の案内に沿ってお並びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please follow staff instructions and remain in line as you proceed to the sales area as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。別の列へ途中で入って二人分のように扱ってもらうことはしません。今日は自分の一つを希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別列で二人分と扱わせず自分の一つを希望すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't join another line midway to have myself treated as two people. Today I'd like one for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not use another line to be treated as two people and would like one item for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 在庫の確認後のご案内となります。なくなった場合も、ご案内をお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you after checking stock. Please listen to the announcement even if the item sells out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入できたか確認する前に約束を増やさず、販売の案内を待ちます。買えなければ友達にもその結果を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入確定前に約束を増やさず結果を友人に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for the sales announcement without making more promises before confirming I've been able to buy it. If I can't, I'll tell my friend that result too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will make no further promises before purchase is confirmed and will tell your friend the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、列でご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please wait in line for further instructions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 練習の場所についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a place to practice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達と歌の練習をしたいです。遊ぶ子どもの声も聞こえるので、小さいマイクなら使ってよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通常の遊び声があるため小型マイクも使えると思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to practice singing with friends. Since I can hear children playing too, I thought using a small microphone would be all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought a small microphone was allowed because ordinary play voices could be heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段の利用の声と、機器を使う練習は分けて確認してください。何人で、いつのご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish normal voices during use of the space from practice using equipment. How many people, and when are you planning this?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三人で今日の午後です。家から充電式のマイクを持ってきましたが、まだ音は出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三人で今日午後の予定で充電式マイクは未使用と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Three of us, this afternoon. I brought a rechargeable microphone from home, but haven't made any sound with it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that three people plan to practice this afternoon and the rechargeable microphone has not been used yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機器の使用や活動の扱いは、管理担当へ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check with management about equipment use and how this activity is classified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。音量が小さいつもりでも、私たちが聞こえる範囲だけで決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己の小音量判断でなく機器使用条件の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help us check. Even if we think the volume is low, I don't want to decide based only on what we can hear around us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check the conditions for equipment use rather than relying on your own judgment that the volume is low. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を使う方や、周囲で過ごす方にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also be considerate of people using the walkway and spending time nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 観客を集める予定はありません。でも、友達が並ぶ場所も通路から外れるよう、担当に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観客予定はなく三人の立ち位置も通路外で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We don't plan to gather an audience. But I'll also ask the person in charge about where my friends can stand outside the walkway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not plan an audience and will discuss positions for all three people off the walkway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで、機器はしまってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the equipment away and wait until the check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は別の場所で練習することもできます。子どもの声を理由に、マイクの許可があるとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 機器をしまい別場所も検討し遊び声を許可根拠にしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We can also practice somewhere else today. I won't claim that children's voices mean we have permission to use a microphone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State that you will put the equipment away, consider another place, and not treat play voices as grounds for permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へお伝えします。それでは、音を出さずにお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass your request to the person in charge. Please wait without making sound. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図のどの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which place on the map are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 出口は左だと思ったのに、表示と違います。携帯に写した図を回して見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の図では出口が左なのに表示と違うと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the exit was on the left, but the signs say otherwise. I was looking at a photo of the map on my phone and had rotated it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why the exit appears on the left in your photo of the map but differs from the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の現在地と、出口の名前を確認しましょう。画面の向きは元の図と同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the current-location marker and the exit name. Is your screen oriented the same way as the original map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 逆さでした。自分の立つ方向と関係なく、写真の左をそのまま駅の左と話してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図を逆さに見て写真の左を実際の左と話したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was upside down. Without considering which way I was facing, I told someone that the left in the photo was the left in the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you viewed the map upside down and described the photo's left as the actual left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 方向だけでなく、出口名や表示を目印にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Use exit names and signs as landmarks, not just directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友達にも左へ来てと送りました。今いる出口名を確かめてから、曖昧な左右の案内を訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人への左という案内を出口名で訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also sent my friend a message saying to come left. I'll check the name of the exit I'm at, then correct those vague left-right directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you will correct your directions telling your friend to go left by using the exit name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手にも、見ている表示と現在地を聞いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask the other person which signs they can see and where they are too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二人が向かい合う方向なら左右も違いますね。出口名を同じ言葉で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 互いの向きで左右が変わるため同じ出口名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If we're facing each other, our left and right will differ too. We'll confirm the same exit name using the same words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the same exit name because left and right change with each person's orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行の妨げにならない所で、位置を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your location somewhere you won't obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 脇で写真の向きを戻し、現在地と出口名を見ます。その名前を友達へ送り、返事を待ってから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 脇で図の向きと現在地を直し返事後に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stand aside, turn the photo back the right way, and check my location and the exit name. I'll send that name to my friend and wait for a reply before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will stand aside, correct the map's orientation, check your location, and move after receiving a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示と合わせてご確認ください。それでは、ご友人と無事にお会いになれますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check it against the signs. I hope you meet your friend safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの案内の日付について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the dates on these two notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 壁の相談会は日程変更とあります。私の個別相談の予約もなくなったと思って、会社へ休みを戻そうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談会の日程変更を個別予約取消しと思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The consultation event on the wall says its date has changed. I thought my individual consultation appointment had been canceled too, and was about to cancel my time off at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the consultation event's schedule change for cancellation of your individual appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談会の案内と、ご自身の予約内容を照らし合わせましょう。予約の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the event notice with your own booking details. Do you have your appointment confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。控えには別の担当名があります。掲示の相談会と同じ相談だと思いましたが、内容も違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別控えの担当と内容が掲示とは違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My confirmation names a different person in charge. I thought it was the same consultation as the posted event, but the subject was different too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the person in charge and subject on your individual confirmation differ from the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ個別予約の状況を確認してから、予定を変更してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the status of your individual appointment with the person in charge before changing your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。会社へ連絡する前に、私の日時が今も有効か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の休みを戻す前に本人予約の有効性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me check. Before contacting my company, I'd like to ask whether my date and time are still valid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether your own appointment remains valid before canceling your time off at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認先へは、予約時の日時とご用件をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the contact the date, time, and purpose given when you booked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの控えどおり伝えます。掲示の変更日を、私の新しい予約日として書き写さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約時情報を伝え掲示日を本人の新予約日としないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them exactly what this confirmation says. I'll make sure not to copy the changed event date as my new appointment date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will provide your booking information and not treat the posted date as your own new appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から確認できた内容を、改めて控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make a fresh note of what the person in charge confirms.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。相談会の掲示と個別予約の返答を分けて残し、確認後に職場の休みを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示と個別返答を分け記録し職場へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll keep the event notice and the reply about my individual appointment separate, then discuss my time off with work after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record the notice and individual reply separately and discuss your leave with work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご予約の担当へおつなぎします。それでは、確認のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to the person handling your appointment. Please wait for guidance on confirmation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明のメモについて、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with your notes on the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬の名前を聞き取れず、知っている市販品の名前に直して書きました。同じ薬だとは確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不明な薬名を知る市販品名へ置換して書いたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I couldn't catch the medicine's name, so I changed it to the name of an over-the-counter product I know when writing it down. I haven't confirmed that it's the same medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you replaced an unclear medicine name with a familiar over-the-counter product name in your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 似て聞こえた名前へ置き換えず、正しい名称を担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than replacing it with a similar-sounding name, let's ask the person in charge for the correct name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ここに書いたのは私の推測です。説明された名称として家族へ送る前に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メモは推測で家族へ送る前に訂正したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. What I've written here is my own guess. I want to correct it before sending it to my family as the name that was explained to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that your note is a guess and you want to correct it before sending it to family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 処方の案内など、名前を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have prescription information or anything else where we can check the name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この紙があります。でも、自分のメモと違うので、同じ物だと勝手にまとめません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 処方案内と自作メモが異なり同じ薬と決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have this paper. But it differs from my notes, so I won't simply group them together as the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the prescription information differs from your own notes and you will not assume they refer to the same medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へメモと案内を一緒に見せてください。使い方も、正式な説明に沿って確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the person in charge both the notes and the information sheet. You also need to check how to use it according to the official explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。市販品について知っている飲み方を、今回の薬へ当てはめることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 知る市販品の飲み方を今回の薬へ当てはめないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me. I won't apply the instructions I know for the over-the-counter product to this medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will not apply the familiar over-the-counter product's dosing instructions to this medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない名称は、書いてもらうようお願いできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can ask them to write down a name you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次から聞き慣れない名前をそのまま尋ねます。今日は正式な名称と説明を確かめてから、家族へ必要な情報を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式名称と説明を確認してから家族へ必要情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I'll ask directly about any unfamiliar name. Today I'll confirm the official name and explanation before passing the necessary information to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the official name and explanation before giving your family the necessary information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ確認の希望を伝えます。それでは、メモと案内をお持ちのままお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge you would like confirmation. Please wait with your notes and the information sheet. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お探しの犬についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the dog you are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。写真を持ってきましたが、昔の首輪が写っています。今の特徴として伝えると違ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬の写真が古い首輪で現在の特徴と違うと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I brought a photo, but it shows an old collar. It would be inaccurate to describe that as its current appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the dog's photo shows an old collar and differs from its current appearance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の首輪と、犬の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me about its current collar and the dog's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は緑の首輪です。写真の赤い首輪ではありません。茶色い体と白い胸の模様は今も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の緑の首輪と変わらない茶色と白い胸模様を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Its collar is green now, not the red one in the photo. Its brown body and white chest marking are still the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the current green collar and unchanged brown body and white chest marking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いつ、どの辺りで見失いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: When and roughly where did you lose sight of it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝、家の近くです。写真を撮った公園で見失ったわけではないので、その場所も区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝家付近で見失い写真撮影公園とは別と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning, near home. It wasn't lost at the park where the photo was taken, so I'll distinguish those places too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you lost sight of it near home this morning, somewhere different from the park in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届いた情報の確認方法や、ほかの相談先を担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the person in charge how to check incoming information and where else you can seek help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。ここへ相談しただけで、ほかの窓口にも全部連絡が済むとは考えません。確認先をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他窓口への連絡は未完で相談先を記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me. I won't assume that consulting here means all the other offices have been contacted too. I'd like to note down whom to contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that other offices have not all been contacted and you want to record where to seek advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかったという連絡が来た場合も、特徴などをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if someone contacts you saying the dog has been found, please check its features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。色だけでうちの犬と決めず、胸の模様と今の首輪も確かめます。古い写真だという説明を付けて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見連絡でも色だけで決めず模様と現在首輪で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't decide it's our dog just from its color; I'll also check its chest marking and current collar. When showing the photo, I'll explain that it's old.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that even with a report of finding it, you will verify the marking and current collar instead of relying on color alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 現在の特徴と見失った場所を担当へ伝えます。それでは、確認先のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge its current features and where you lost sight of it. Please wait for guidance on whom to contact. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いたお手紙についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a letter you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 亡くなった父宛ての封書が届きました。家に来たので、私が開けて父として返事をしてよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 死亡した父宛封書を自分が開け本人名で返答してよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A sealed letter addressed to my late father arrived. Since it came to our house, I'm unsure whether I may open it and reply as my father.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may open a sealed letter addressed to your deceased father and reply in his name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、内容やお客様の権限を判断できません。まず届いた状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine its contents or your authority here. First, please tell us how it arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封は開けていません。差出人は表に書いてあります。父に代わって同じ名前で返すつもりにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封で父の名前のまま返答したくないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't opened it. The sender is written on the outside. I don't want to decide to reply in my father's place using his name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that it is unopened and you do not want to reply using your father's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 差出人への連絡や、郵便の取扱いについての相談先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check how to contact the sender and where to ask about handling the mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。差出人へ父が亡くなったと伝える時も、私が家族だと名乗って話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 差出人へ家族である自分の立場で死亡を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me. When I tell the sender my father has died, I'll identify myself as his family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will inform the sender of the death in your own capacity as a family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容については差出人の担当へご相談ください。封筒の情報は手元に残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please discuss the contents with the sender's representative. Keep the envelope information at hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。中身が請求か案内か、外からは分からないので、支払いが必要とも不要とも決めずに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容は不明なので請求や支払義務を外から決めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I can't tell from the outside whether it's a bill or a notice, so I'll ask without deciding either that payment is required or that it isn't.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that the contents are unknown, so you will not judge from the outside whether it is a bill or whether payment is owed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 郵便の扱いと、差出人への内容確認は分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you separately on handling the mail and checking its contents with the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。未開封の状態と父宛てだということを説明し、私の名前で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封と父宛の事情を自分名で説明して相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll explain in my own name that it is unopened and addressed to my father, and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will explain that it is unopened and addressed to your father and seek advice in your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お手紙の取扱いの確認先をご案内します。それでは、ご相談の内容を担当へお伝えください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to the contact for checking how to handle the letter. Please tell the person in charge what you wish to discuss. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 勤務先へ伝える口座情報についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the bank account information to give your employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。通帳の最後のページを撮って送りそうになりました。口座の番号だけでなく、残高と買い物の記録も写っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座情報用写真に残高と取引記録も写ると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I nearly sent a photo of the last page of my passbook. It shows not only my account number but also my balance and shopping transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a photo intended to show account details also includes your balance and transaction history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先が必要としている項目を確認し、関係のない情報まで送らないようになさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check which details your employer needs and avoid sending unrelated information as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の案内では銀行名、支店、口座の種類と番号、名前です。買い物の履歴は求められていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の必要項目を読み履歴は不要と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The company instructions ask for the bank name, branch, account type and number, and name. They haven't asked for my shopping history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the employer's required fields and make clear that the history is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を確認できる資料や表示について、担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the person in charge about documents or displays where those details can be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。写真を加工して数字を消すより、最初から必要な口座情報だけを確認して伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 加工より必要情報だけを確認できる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me. Rather than edit a photo to erase numbers, I'd like to check and share only the necessary account details from the outset.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a way to check only the necessary information instead of editing a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な記載が正しいか、ご自身でも照らし合わせてください。暗証番号は口座情報として伝えるものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare the required details yourself to ensure they are correct. A PIN is not something to give as account information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号の言い違いも避けたいので、元の記録を見て確認します。暗証番号は会社にも知らせません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座情報を元記録で照合し暗証番号は会社へ知らせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also want to avoid misstating the number, so I'll check the original record. I won't tell my company my PIN either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will compare the account details with the original record and will not give your employer your PIN. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社への提出方法は、勤務先の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check your employer's instructions for how to submit the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要項目だけを正しい方法で渡します。残高の写真は送らず、提出用の情報を確認してからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務先の提出方法を確認し残高写真は送らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll provide only the necessary fields in the correct way. I won't send the balance photo; I'll check the information for submission first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the employer's submission method and will not send the balance photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な情報の確認を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand over your request to check the necessary information to the person in charge. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: キャンペーンの案内についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the promotion information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このお菓子を買えば応募できると思いました。家の箱と同じ絵なので、前に買った分も使えるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ絵の菓子なら過去購入分も懸賞応募に使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought buying these sweets would let me enter. The picture is the same as on the box at home; can I also use ones I bought before?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether previously purchased sweets with the same picture can be used to enter the prize draw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象期間と応募条件をご確認ください。今の案内には、購入の記録が必要とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the eligible period and entry conditions. The current notice says proof of purchase is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前のレシートは捨てました。箱の絵だけでは、いつ買ったかも確認できないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧レシートなしで包装絵だけでは購入時期不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I threw away the old receipt. The picture on the box alone doesn't even show when I bought it, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you have no old receipt and the packaging picture alone cannot establish when you bought it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な対象商品や数量、提出する記録も、案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the notice for the eligible products, quantities, and records you need to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ名前でも対象の容量が決まっていますね。今回はこの大きい袋ではなく、対象の品か確かめて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象容量を読み今回の候補が該当するか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even with the same name, the eligible package size is specified. This time I'd like to check and choose an eligible product rather than this large bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the eligible package size and check whether the item you are considering qualifies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 応募のためにご購入される場合も、条件を確認してからお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if you are buying to enter, please check the conditions before deciding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。抽選に当たる前提で買い足しません。食べる量も考え、条件が合う分だけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当選前提で買足さず食べる量と条件で選ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't buy extra on the assumption I'll win the draw. I'll consider how much I'll eat and choose only an amount that meets the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not buy extra assuming you will win, and will choose based on how much you will eat and the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レシートの提出方法や、店への問い合わせ先と応募先の違いもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check how to submit the receipt and the difference between the store's inquiry contact and the entry destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 購入後はレシートを残し、応募先の案内を読みます。店で買ったことと応募完了を同じに考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートを残し店での購入と応募完了を区別すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: After buying, I'll keep the receipt and read the instructions for where to enter. I'll avoid treating buying at the store as the same as completing an entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the receipt and distinguish purchasing at the store from completing an entry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、ご条件と必要な量を見てお選びください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please choose with the conditions and the amount you need in mind. Goodbye.
